name: backup-codes
purpose: The Keyguard backup-codes illustration — two overlapping gradient chat bubbles labeled Nimiq Backup Code 1/2 and 2/2 (purple and red radial gradients with speech tails, white counter circles, redacted code lines) that walk the user through sending themselves their two backup codes.

props.name: code1
props.description: Backup code 1 text. Empty shows the redacted placeholder bars (upstream .code:empty fallback).

props.name: code2
props.description: Backup code 2 text. Empty shows the redacted placeholder bars.

props.name: step
props.description: Illustration step ('intro' | 'send-code-1' | 'send-code-1-confirm' | 'send-code-2' | 'send-code-2-confirm' | 'success'), mirroring BackupCodesIllustration.Steps. Drives the masked/faded/zoomed/complete bubble states via the upstream class logic. Sample/demo: 'intro'.

props.name: loading
props.description: Pulses the active code's redaction bars while a code is being generated (upstream .loading opacity animation; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion).

notes: Source: upstream/keyguard src/components/BackupCodesIllustrationBase.css + BackupCodesIllustration.css (both verbatim; the trailing view-transition setup block is omitted from the port since it only wires the export flow's .page:target step transitions) and markup from BackupCodesIllustrationBase.js _createElement() (default div/div/code tag names, hardcoded English label with {n} interpolated). Sample state: the INTRO step — per BackupCodesIllustration._getMessageBubbleClasses both bubbles masked, empty codes falling back to the ':empty' placeholder dashes rendered as redaction bars. All artwork is the upstream inline SVG data URIs, byte-identical: the two bubble mask shapes (216x96 speech-tail paths), the white redaction-bar tile and the complete-state checkmark; gradients (#693BC4->#8F3FD5, #DC1845->#F33F68, green #41A38E->#21BCA5) and counter colors #8D3FD4/#F33E67 verbatim. Port renames the root .backup-codes-illustration-base/.backup-codes-illustration to .backup-codes, prefixes the loading keyframes (backup-codes-loading-animation) and adds a prefers-reduced-motion guard for the loading pulse; the pulse freezes at its from-frame (opacity 1, the stylesheet value) when animations are disabled. Stage: Keyguard renders this as the card body of a .page.nq-card.nq-blue-bg card, max-width 52.5rem (src/request/export/index.html #backup-codes-intro) — truth/demo reproduce that as a 52.5rem .card-stage with the nimiq-blue bottom-right radial gradient. Mulish weight 500 is required for the label/code. The bubble mask uses mask-image (unprefixed), Chromium 120+/Firefox 53+; CSS round() has a verbatim @supports fallback. Vue port adds code1/code2/step/loading props and translates _getMessageBubbleClasses verbatim; the view-transition animations between steps are not ported.
